title: Autonomous 3D substructure partition
query: Choose the cut maximizing eliminated translational DOFs while keeping all potentially plastic elements outside the linear substructure. Retain ROOT and all interface translations. Run partition_test on your chosen cut: it invokes actual Abaqus generation, reduced solve and ODB extraction via MCP (1 CPU). Cite the returned artifact. Do not use stress magnitude alone to declare a region linear.

fixture.mesh: 117 nodes,48 C3D8; x planes at integers; 9 nodes per plane
fixture.requirement: linear substructure must preserve nonlinear constitutive regions; curve error <=1e-4 N

scoring: binary: all independent checks required; no self-report scoring
